This new instruction gives the operator on the floor a clear, actionable task to complete, prompting him to immediately call the control room with the required status update. The change described above is the whole difference between the two versions.
dim_task#v2: A meeting transcript originally listed the next meeting date as "TBD." The editor changed it to "Thursday, 10 AM." Seeing this specific time, a participant immediately replied to the group confirming their attendance. The change described above is the whole difference between the two versions.

dim_discourse#v2: A city council meeting transcript originally listed the final agenda item as "Public Comments." The clerk changed it to "Public Comments (Non-Agenda Items Only)." qual_certainty#v1:

The change described above is the whole difference between the two versions.

qual_conditionality#v2: A meeting transcript originally stated, "The team will approve the budget." qual_sentiment#v1: A customer service chat transcript originally read, "I'll look into that for you." An employee added the word 'happily' so it now says, "I'll happily look into that for you." qual_sentiment#v2: A court reporter adds the word "sarcastically" in parentheses before a witness's reply in the official transcript.
